about_the_game:
A space roguelike, where you fight waves and decipher the language of your enemies..

This game has two core gameloops:
1. Defeat waves of enemy spaceships, update your attack "modules", collect relics, items and even more modules to create powerful synergies.

2. Everything is written in a foreign language. You have to try out new modules and interact with the enemies to learn the language. The more you learn, the better you can strategize

These two gameloops go hand in hand to progress further and further in the game.
In typical roguelike fashion, you have to try over and over again against randomized dangers and events to finally figure out how to beat the game.

The majority of gameplay is on the radar-like game area of you main HUD. You use your mouse to grab your ship and let it slingshot towards the enemies. You fight by ramming enemies or using your modules after you stopped your movement. Strategies can involve increasing your ramming power, focusing on melee attacks, shooting, throwing bombs or even use status effects to control enemy waves.

You play "Blightseed": a powerful AI, send out to stop an alien fleet before it reaches our solar system. Your mission: Hold them back and learn their intentions. The more you learn to speak their language, the more complex this conflict becomes.

Contents:
-4 stages to fight through
-9 different bosses
-over 50 different modules
-over 70 different relics
-around 200 glyphs to learn
-a story presented in small pieces for you to deduce the complex layers of a deep conflict
-a deeper layer to explore your enemies minds

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3210 / AMD A8-7600 or equivalent (dual-core, ~2.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon HD 7480D (or any DX11-compatible GPU with 128MB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent (quad-core, ~3.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel UHD Graphics 630 / AMD Radeon Vega 8 (or any DX11 GPU with 1GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: A space roguelike, where you fight waves and decipher the language of your enemies. Take breaks between fast action sequences, to translate the attacks and buffs you collected. The more you understand the easier it will be to find the winning synergies to defeat your foes.
